title: Raw Detail Extension
description: Detailed per-channel arrays and raw BIDS sidecar content. This extension holds the verbose data that was previously in the core MongoDB documents (channel_names, channel_types, channel_tsv, eeg_json). Separated from core to allow lean queries that skip large arrays.

channel_types.description: Ordered list of channel types (parallel to channel_names).

channel_tsv.description: Parsed content of the BIDS channels.tsv file.

eeg_json.description: Parsed content of the BIDS EEG sidecar JSON (*_eeg.json). Contains task description, equipment info, filter settings, etc.

participant_tsv.description: Parsed row from the BIDS participants.tsv for this subject.

bids_dependencies.description: List of BIDS sidecar file paths that this record depends on.

electrode_tsv.description: Parsed content of the BIDS electrodes.tsv file (electrode names, coordinates).

events_tsv.description: Parsed content of the BIDS events.tsv file (onset, duration, trial_type columns).
